response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(ss.record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM status_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE ss.share > a.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each distinct healtheval value, including NULL as its own group, is one status group; a record contributes only when its zoneref matches a site code. Shares use all matched conservation records as the denominator, and the above-average threshold is the unweighted mean of the status-group shares.
